intent: Fix Home Environment Manager dashboard metric tiles where selected unavailable/unsupported sources display long raw sensor.* entity identifiers overlapping adjacent metric cards. Use compact localized labels e.g. Illumination/Φωτισμός and constrain heading layout without inventing supported measurements.
note: Only frontend presentation of metric tile labels, clipping/wrapping and source tooltips changes. Preserve Recorder-safe dashboard WebSocket from b37, current entities, raw measurements, selected source IDs, HA services, translations and all physical device safety.
changes: Render compact user-readable metric headings instead of the full sensor.entity_id whenever an unknown/unavailable selected input has no friendly display name.

Resolve common sensor suffixes/device classes (illuminance/illumination, presence/occupancy, motion, temperature, humidity, pressure, noise) to localized English/Greek/German/French/Spanish short labels, with sensible fallback for other locales.
Retain genuine short custom friendly names and shorten arbitrary long unknown identifiers to a compact final descriptive suffix.
Keep the original exact entity ID and full friendly name in the heading tooltip; do not classify unsupported inputs as valid sensor readings.
Use a confined flex heading with 2-line ellipsis/clamp and flexible numeric value placement so tiles cannot bleed into each other in narrow layouts.

Add Node regression checks for bathroom illumination/presence sensors, Greek/German/English titles, unknown source identity, full source tooltip, readable unsupported states and escaped hostile sensor names.
Keep canonical environment_manager domain, b37 Recorder budget/full WS dashboard, and prior beta native controls unchanged; no migrations, hardware service or other integration edits.
Gate publication on Node, Python 3.13/3.14, real Home Assistant 2026.10, HACS/Hassfest, translations and exact flat HACS tag payload.
